images.title: 94 × 11 by adding neighbours
images.purpose: Shows 94 × 11 done in one line: the last digit copied, the neighbours 9 and 4 added, then the carry.
images.composition: The two digits of 94 on top, with the four answer digits below joined by short arrows. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: At the top, the label '94 × 11' in large digits. Below, the answer '1034' in large reddish purple (#CC79A7) digits. Three short arrows lead to the answer digits, each with a small tag: a teal (#0072B2) tag '4' pointing to the last digit 4; an amber (#E69F00) tag '9 + 4 = 13' pointing to the digit 3; a teal tag '9 + 1 = 10' pointing to the first two digits 10. Exactly 3 arrows and 3 tags.
